mandatory_global_cautions: No full SNC proof or actual finite all-deficient example is known from this project.
The numeric residual frontier remains R>=7, even order R>=8. No new R7 partition was excluded in global rounds two or three.
Every theorem must carry its own minimality/strong-connectivity/closure/equality hypotheses.
Complete publication novelty is not implied by internal adversarial reviews.
Reports of previous independent reviews are inherited provenance, not a claim this inventory repeated all checks.
External manuscripts and imported solver packages require correct authorship attribution.
An all-results manuscript can preserve superseded results through a coverage table and supplementary proofs without repeating them as independent headline contributions.
